content:
anita: Quick sync — we need to finalise the KEK refresh/deprecation plan for envelope headers across AWS/GCP/Azure. Compliance wants a clear deprecation window and an emergency manual rewrap path. Thoughts?

chris: Couple quick constraints: CloudTrail/Cloud Audit logs need to show rewrap actor + key version. For AWS that means KMS API Call logging; for GCP use Cloud Audit Logs; Azure => Key Vault diagnostic logs. Make sure retention is set to 1 year for audits. :lock:

raj: On RBAC, we'll need a temporary grant model for the rewrap jobs. For AWS create a short-lived IAM role with kms:Decrypt/kms:Encrypt + kms:ReEncrypt? (we use ReEncrypt flow). For GCP IAM principal needs cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt/useToDecrypt. Azure needs Key Vault 'wrapKey'/'unwrapKey' permissions. Recommend using workload identity or short-lived STS creds.

maria: Backwards compatibility: keep old header version handling in runtime for 30 days post-rollout. Add header field "kek_version" in ciphertext metadata. Runtime should try current KEK then fallback to previous version for reads; writes always use new KEK version.

jordan: Canary plan idea: kick off canary rewrap on a sample shard (1k objects) with metrics: rewrap_success_rate, latency, rewrap_error_rate, and corrupt_detected. If error_rate > 0.5% abort and rollback. Staged % rollout: 1% (1h) -> 10% (24h) -> 50% (48h) -> 100% (7d).

anita: Good. How do we trigger manual rewrap for emergency vuln triage? Need a documented runbook and a safelist for operators.

chris: Runbook stub: include required RBAC arns, audit checklist, preflight queries, and dry-run mode. Example command for our rewrap job:

```
# dry-run, prints candidates and actions
kubectl run rewrap-job --image=redwood/rewrap:canary -- \
  --dry-run --prefix-prefix="env/prod/" --from-key="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/old-kek" --to-kek-version="v2"
```

raj: Also add a force-rewrap endpoint guarded by two-person approval (sig-ops + security). That endpoint emits an audit event in the central audit pipeline (we'll tag events with rewrap:manual).

maria: KMS provider specifics: AWS supports multi-Region keys and grants - use grants for service accounts where possible. GCP requires separate key versions; rotating means creating new CryptoKeyVersion and setting primary. Azure: create a new key version and update Key Vault reference. Confirm SDKs handle unwrap/wrap with explicit version IDs.

devsecops-bot: deploy-bot: Observability checklist created: greps for rewrap_error_rate, ciphertext_header_mismatch, rewrap_dur_seconds. Alerts: paging on rewrap_error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m.

anita: Recording decisions: 1) Add header "kek_version", maintain fallback to prior version for 30d. 2) RBAC: short-lived role/grant + two-person approval for manual run. 3) Audit: emit structured event on every rewrap (actor, src_key, dst_kek_version, object_id). 4) Rollout schedule as jordan suggested and canary first. 5) Emergency manual runbook + dry-run required before live run.

chris: One more: define data corruption check after rewrap: try decrypt + re-encrypt test vector for 100 samples per shard. If checksum mismatch, halt and alert.

raj: I'll draft the runbook and add the IAM policy snippets. Ping me for review.

anita: Thanks — can we aim to have the runbook + IAM snippets in the doc repo by EOD tomorrow? If yes I'll open the compliance ticket with proposed deprecation dates. :white_check_mark:
